Nevada Northern Railway hosts its first Make-A-Wish family

October 18, 2026 by The Ely Times 1 Comment

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:45
Instaread

The Nevada Northern Railway welcomed its first Make-A-Wish family recently, fulfilling the dream of a young Reno boy seeking his first ride on a full-scale locomotive.

The Mannens family traveled from Reno to Ely to celebrate their eldest son, Koe, whose fascination with trains began while playing with a model railway set during medical treatments at Stanford Medical Center. Koe has navigated significant health challenges stemming from hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, a rare and serious immune condition. Following extensive treatments in California, Koe underwent a bone marrow transplant in late 2025.

Because his ongoing recovery left him immunocompromised and required him to avoid crowded public spaces, Koe’s parents, Kristina and Matt, searched for a destination capable of accommodating his health needs. The family chose the Nevada Northern Railway because Ely’s remote setting made it possible to arrange a safe, low-exposure experience.

To ensure a safe visit, railway staff coordinated a private journey aboard a historic caboose, giving Koe an up-close look at vintage rail operations. The railway also hosted a private excursion on its seasonal Pumpkin Train, allowing Koe and his siblings, Karter and Kit, to tour the tracks and pick out their own pumpkins.

Railway officials emphasized that their mission as a National Historic Landmark and living museum extends beyond preserving historic rolling stock, noting the importance of sharing rail heritage with young visitors facing critical medical battles.

Local youth also help sustain similar efforts across the region. Each spring, the local National Honor Society chapter organizes an annual Wish Week fundraiser at the high school, raising community funds to support Make-A-Wish Nevada in granting wishes for children facing critical illnesses.

To learn more about HLH, visit https://www.hlh-heroes.org/.

Learn more about Make-A-Wish Nevada and how to get involved by visiting https://wish.org/nv.
